name: Tantric Agony (Racial)
body:
You twist the beguiling nature of your fey heritage, intertwining pleasure and pain like sinewy dancers. Your precision attacks leave an opponent’s knees quivering in ecstasy.

Prerequisite: Dex 15, Cha 13, Svartalfar, ability to inflict sneak attack damage

Benefit: When making a sneak attack as a standard action, you may sacrifice one die of sneak attack damage to instead leave your target dazzled for 1d6 rounds. Creatures that are immune to mind-affecting effects or sneak attack damage are not susceptible to Tantric Agony.
